title: Chapter 284: Extreme Pressure
content:
Chapter 284: Extreme Pressure

Whenever the Zerg Puppies can no longer attack in a certain direction, the Zerg Explosive Mosquitoes will launch a self-destruct attack on the alien army in that direction.

The Zerg Puppies continue to rush into the alien city of Jiujiuliu to consolidate the city territory occupied by the Zerg. Once the territory is in their mouths, they must not spit it out easily.

The Zerg has invested tens of millions of troops in this all-out attack, and through fierce attacks, they continue to put pressure on the alien army.

In the alien city of Jiujiuliu, more alien troops on standby joined the battle to block the attacks of the Zerg Puppies and the three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions.

The fierce city blocking battle caused heavy losses to both sides, and a large number of Zerg Puppies and alien troops were killed every moment.

The number of three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions is also constantly decreasing.

On the front battlefield opposite the main combat position of the Zerg, the Zerg Puppies and three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions that entered the city attacked deep into the city again.

In order to cooperate with their attack, the phalanx of the main combat arms of the Zerg began to advance slowly.

The attack of the Zerg destroyers gradually extended to the depths of the 996 city of the alien race.

All the organized armies of the alien race within the attack range of the Zerg destroyers were blown to pieces by them, and the surviving soldiers could only hide everywhere.

They either retreated or went forward to fight to the death with the Zerg puppies. Facing the Zerg puppies' clearing, they did not even dare to enter the underground bunker.

The air force in the 996 city of the alien race finally went out. Under the leadership of the light griffin, they launched an attack on the attacking Zerg puppies and the three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions.

The strength of this air force of the alien race is equivalent to that of the Zerg air mobile force, which is also about 500,000.

They were divided into several groups, and within the scope of the 996 city of the alien race, they cooperated with other alien arms that were blocking and attacked the Zerg puppies and the three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions on the ground.

The attacking Type III Zerg Toxic Ray Scorpion immediately entered air defense mode, and shot terrible green rays at the flying soldiers of the alien race in the air.

The flying soldiers of the alien race would be poisoned and injured if they were hit by a poisonous ray. The toxicity of the Type III Zerg Toxic Ray Scorpion was enhanced by the biotechnology of the Zerg and was very strong.

The flying soldiers of the alien race also focused on attacking the Type III Zerg Toxic Ray Scorpion scattered in the Zerg puppy group.

The Zerg air mobile forces that had not participated in the battle were dispatched collectively. Two thousand five-star Zerg queens who were waiting for the restoration of their egg-laying ability exerted parasitic control on the Bright Griffins, which had the strongest comprehensive strength in the air forces of the alien race.

Zerg queens consume a lot of resources, but their abilities are really powerful.

Except for the rule-level egg-laying attack, which cannot be used continuously, the other abilities of the five-star Zerg queen can be used continuously with the support of sufficient energy.

Two thousand five-star Zerg queens controlled almost all the light griffins in the alien air force in a very short time.

Most of the light griffins were only one-star in strength, and the five-star Zerg queens could control a large number of them using parasitic control ability.

The light griffins, the core arms of the alien air force, suddenly launched a counterattack, and a large number of light attribute energy balls exploded in other alien flying arms.

The light griffins turned back and rushed into the flying arms of other alien races, with sharp beaks and claws, quickly killing, injuring, and shooting down the flying arms of other alien races who were unable to react.

More than 500,000 Zerg flying dragons simultaneously attacked the air and ground forces of the alien army.

A large number of biological bombs exploded, and countless micro-biological bombs flew around, chasing the alien army and exploding.

The huge Zerg flying dragon group cooperated with the light griffin controlled by the Zerg Queen to quickly destroy one of the alien air forces, and helped the Zerg dogs on the ground to clear the road, and then flew to another alien air force.

Seeing that the air forces were about to be defeated one by one, the aliens sent out a powerful air defense force including their own elite archers to cover the alien air forces to withdraw back to the city.

The Zerg parasitized the light griffin and tried to chase it. They found that the anti-aircraft firepower of the alien army was very fierce, so they stopped chasing and followed the Zerg flying dragon group to retreat to the safe area outside the city.

In the 996 city of the aliens, except for the elite troops of the aliens, the armies of other affiliated races almost all participated in the war. They constantly blocked the combined attack of the Zerg dogs and the three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions.

With the continuous consumption of the forces of both sides, especially the continuous advancement of the main combat arms of the Zerg, it put a lot of pressure on the alien army.

In the center of the 996th city of the alien race, the large space transmission channel that had not been activated began to work, and hundreds of thousands of alien race troops were transmitted in batches each time.

These troops continued to be deployed on the battlefield, gradually blocking the offensive of the Zerg Puppies.

With the continuous loss of the three-type Zerg Toxic Ray Scorpions and the reduction of the support of the Zerg Explosive Mosquitoes, the Zerg Puppies faced reinforcements, and the organized alien race army was a little unable to fight.

Feeling that the time was almost right, Wu Qing let the Zerg Puppies and the three-type Zerg Toxic Ray Scorpions burrow into the ground and no longer actively attack.

In an instant, except for the main battlefield, all other battles stopped. All the Zerg puppies and Type III Zerg poisonous ray scorpions that were attacking the city all burrowed into the ground and disappeared.

The alien army lost their opponent. They had no way to deal with the Zerg army that didn't know how deep it had burrowed into the ground.

Those mages and other strong men who could attack underground targets were a minority after all. Putting them on a battlefield of this scale, they were just a drop in the bucket and had no effect at all.

Judging from the large-scale battlefield magic effects of the alien mages, the Zerg army would not be injured by the magic of terrain change and squeezing underground.

Looking at the empty battlefield in front of them, the alien army did not dare to set foot on it. The Zerg puppies could come out at any time. Without the advantage of a well-organized formation, they would not be able to gain an advantage by running into a melee with the Zerg puppies.

The alien army was even a little afraid that the Zerg puppies would sneak under their feet. The aliens had already dispatched a large number of earth magicians and began to use earth magic to reinforce the ground like the Naga tribe to prevent the Zerg puppies from sneaking under their feet from underground.

The Naga mages were able to easily reinforce the desert main city. First, the current area of the desert main city was very small compared to the 996 city of the aliens.

Second, the Naga tribe knew that the sand in the desert environment needed to be reinforced, and they were well prepared.

Third, the Naga tribe itself was a race with an affinity for the earth element, and every Naga mage could easily cast earth magic.

The aliens did not have these conditions. They believed in the Lord of Light, and most of them were light mages. It was not easy to find enough mages who could cast powerful earth magic at once.

Not to mention that it was impossible to reinforce the ground of the 996 city, which was so large, at once, and it was also a huge waste.

With this time and energy, it is better to send more troops. No matter where the Zerg army comes out, just go straight to it. The alien army is not unable to beat the Zerg puppies.

If the Zerg main combat arms come out from underground, it will be a great thing for the aliens. The alien army is worried that it cannot rush to the main combat arms of the Zerg.

Of course, under certain conditions, in some areas, it is not inconsistent with this idea to prevent the underground raid of the Zerg army.

…

The full-scale attack of the Zerg army consumes a large number of the troops of the alien army, forcing the aliens to open the space transmission channel to allow more alien troops to be transmitted.

After this goal is achieved, the full-scale attack of the Zerg army stops, and only the direction of the Zerg main combat arms remains, and the battle has not stopped.

With the powerful firepower support of the Zerg destroyer, the Zerg puppies and the three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions in this direction are only responsible for clearing the remaining enemies. The battle is much easier and the losses are not great.

Their main losses came from the ultra-long-range siege equipment of the aliens and the attacks of the alien mages.

As the aliens continued to increase their troops, the air defense of the alien army became stronger and stronger. With the addition of more ultra-long-range siege equipment of the aliens, many ultra-long-range attacks of the alien army were directed at the Zerg main combat phalanx.

Millions of Zerg Hydralisks provided a giant air defense umbrella for the Zerg main combat phalanx.

Zerg destroyers began to exchange fire with the ultra-long-range siege equipment of the aliens, and Zerg Hydralisk began to compete with the air defense firepower of the alien air defense forces.

The two sides fought like this for a while, and the Zerg main combat phalanx, under the order of Wu Qing, began to retreat actively and withdrew from this meaningless mutual attack.

The Zerg puppies and the three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions in front drilled into the ground on the spot and occupied the city territory that had been captured.

The Zerg destroyers retreated to the starting position to rest and no longer used firepower to suppress the alien army.

The five-star Zerg Queen's spawning attack, while leaving 500 unmoved, continued to kill the alien mages, and the alien mages guarded by the mysterious chariot were killed to less than 3,000 people.

The space transmission channel in the center of the alien city of Jiujiuli has never stopped since it was opened, and reinforcements of the order of 100,000 have been continuously transmitted.

The troops lost by the alien army in Jiujiuli City were soon made up, and the troops of the alien army in Jiujiuli City began to increase rapidly.

Wu Qing saw all this through the Zerg host.

"You attack once, I attack once, and now it's your turn again!"

Wu Qing was satisfied with the reaction of the aliens. As long as this battle continued, his goal would be achieved.
